name: Sudi Bjornstad Korba
title: Senior Vice President of Sales, North America
bio: Sudi Bjornstad Korba is the Senior Vice President of Sales for North America at Darwinbox and leads revenue strategy and expansion for the US market. Her expertise in modernizing HR processes, enhancing operations & employee experiences for large enterprises has led her to several leadership roles. Notable are the ones at UKG (formerly Ultimate Software) and PSAV (now Encore Global), a background that gives her unique insight into the evolving challenges faced by HR teams today.

name: Q Hamirani
title: Chief People Officer
bio: Q Hamirani is a Chief People Officer at HighLevel, an innovative SaaS company focused on remote work and people strategy. With a background in HR and AI, he has previously held leadership roles at Airbnb and Paper, where he contributed to significant organizational changes and initiatives. Q is passionate about personal growth, community building, and the intersection of technology and human resources. He actively engages in discussions about the future of work, remote culture, and educational transformation.
